reading.body:
NTT Ashburn VA7 has 36 MW of published IT capacity. Assuming 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, this corresponds to roughly 900 racks. At typical power ratios for large language model training, this translates to capacity for roughly 1,100 to 1,400 accelerators depending on configuration. The facility spans 125,000 square feet.

This campus ranks 14th among the 26 data center facilities in Virginia with published megawatt figures. Virginia's mapped facilities total 332 sites, but only 26 disclose capacity. With 36 MW, Ashburn VA7 represents 2.2 percent of Virginia's published 1,639.4 MW of data center capacity. No certifications are published for this facility.

The campus sits in Ashburn, Virginia's primary data center hub, where most of the state's published capacity concentrates. Whether this facility matters to AI scaling depends on its grid connection and whether it is reserved for AI workloads. Neither is published.
